turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Jamie calling from Maple Bank. This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: May I with Anouk Allard?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Speaking.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Before we continue, can you please confirm your date of birth?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, it's [PII].

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks. Is this still the best number to reach you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, this is my cell.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I'm calling about your account with Maple Bank, which is past due.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Give me a second while I open your file.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, I see the account here.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The amount past due today is $75.95.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Honestly, I can't afford that amount. Our house flooded, we're staying with family.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I already made a payment and it wasn't applied.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand. I'll note that on the file and have it reviewed.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: We had to leave our house because of the fire.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I want to make a complaint about how many times you call.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. We have hardship options, like a reduced payment for three months. Would you like me to review that with you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that would help.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'll make a note on the file so the hardship team can review your situation.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: should hear from them within a few business days.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I can pay $46 next payday.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Just to confirm, a payment of $45.92 on September 13. I'll send you a payment link.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Will you be paying through the app or online banking?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Through the app.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Perfect.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Before I transfer you, we can also set up a payment plan.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you have any other questions for me?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, I think that's it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for your time today. You'll receive a confirmation by text. Have a good evening.
